## 2. Tech Stack

### Frontend
- React 19 + Vite 8
- React Router DOM v7 (BrowserRouter, SPA)
- Framer Motion 13 (page transitions, scroll animations)
- Lenis (smooth scroll)
- Lucide React (icons)
- CSS custom properties (theming, dark/light mode)

### Backend
- Express 5 (Node.js)
- MongoDB + Mongoose 9 (primary database)
- JWT (jsonwebtoken) for session authentication
- bcryptjs for password hashing
- Nodemailer for transactional email
- express-rate-limit for API rate limiting
- Helmet for HTTP security headers

### Deployment
- Vercel (serverless, production)
- GitHub: https://github.com/byteblazehunar/hunartheskillhouse
- Branch: main (production), byteblaze-rewrite (development)
- API entry: api/index.js → server/vercelHandler.js → server/apiRouter.js

---

## 3. Architecture

```
hunar-web-app/
├── src/                    Frontend React app
│   ├── App.jsx             Root component, routing, layout
│   ├── pages/              21 page components
│   ├── components/         Shared UI (Navbar, Footer, SeoManager, etc.)
│   │   └── admin/          Admin-only components (CMSManager, RoleManagement)
│   ├── data/               Static data (courses, FAQ, blog, SEO metadata)
│   ├── context/            ThemeContext, SiteContentContext
│   └── hooks/              usePublicCatalog, usePortalTab, useScrollReveal
├── server/                 Express backend
│   ├── server.js           Main Express app
│   ├── apiRouter.js        All API route definitions (~1900 lines)
│   ├── vercelHandler.js    Vercel serverless entry point
│   ├── middleware/
│   │   └── authMiddleware.js   JWT auth, RBAC, student isolation
│   ├── services/
│   │   └── dataService.js  MongoDB + JSON fallback data layer
│   ├── models/             Mongoose models (User, Student, Staff, Batch, etc.)
│   ├── utils/
│   │   ├── auth.js         JWT sign/verify, bcrypt, token generation
│   │   └── idGenerator.js  HUN-S-XXXX / HUN-T-XXXX ID generation
│   └── config/
│       └── db.js           MongoDB connection with validation
├── api/
│   └── index.js            Vercel serverless function entry
├── scripts/
│   └── prerender-seo.js    Build-time static HTML generation for all routes
├── public/
│   ├── sitemap.xml         27 URLs with lastmod/changefreq/priority
│   ├── robots.txt          Allows all + AI crawlers, blocks portal/api/admin
│   ├── llms.txt            Short AI crawler summary
│   └── llms-full.txt       This file
└── vercel.json             Vercel build config + security headers + rewrites
```

## 6. API Endpoints

All API routes are under /api/ and require Bearer JWT token unless noted.

### Authentication
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | /api/auth/login | None | Login with loginId + password |
| POST | /api/auth/activate | None | Activate invited account, set password |
| GET | /api/auth/verify-invitation/:token | None | Validate invitation token |
| GET | /api/auth/me | Bearer | Get authenticated user profile |
| POST | /api/auth/forgot-password | None | Request password reset email |

### Students
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /api/students | Bearer + permission | List all students |
| POST | /api/students | Bearer + admin | Create student + invite email |
| GET | /api/students/:id | Bearer + isolation | Get student by ID |
| PUT | /api/students/:id | Bearer + admin | Update student |
| DELETE | /api/students/:id | Bearer + admin | Delete student |
| GET | /api/attendance/student | Bearer + student | Get own attendance |

### Staff
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /api/staff | Bearer + permission | List all staff |
| POST | /api/staff | Bearer + admin | Create staff + invite email |
| GET | /api/staff/:id | Bearer | Get staff by ID |
| PUT | /api/staff/:id | Bearer + admin | Update staff |
| DELETE | /api/staff/:id | Bearer + admin | Delete staff |

### Batches
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /api/batches | Bearer + batches.view | List all active batches |
| GET | /api/public/batches | None | Public batch timings |
| POST | /api/batches | Bearer + admin | Create batch |
| PUT | /api/batches/:id | Bearer + admin | Update batch |
| DELETE | /api/batches/:id | Bearer + admin | Delete batch |

### Courses
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /api/courses | None | Public course catalog |
| POST | /api/courses | Bearer + admin | Create course |
| PUT | /api/courses/:id | Bearer + admin | Update course |
| DELETE | /api/courses/:id | Bearer + admin | Delete course |

### Assignments
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /api/assignments | Bearer + teacher/admin | List assignments |
| POST | /api/assignments | Bearer + teacher | Create assignment |
| POST | /api/assignments/:id/submit | Bearer + student | Submit assignment |

### Attendance
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | /api/attendance | Bearer + teacher | Record attendance for batch |
| GET | /api/attendance/student | Bearer + student | Student's own attendance |

### Fees

### Announcements

| POST | /api/announcements | Bearer + teacher/admin | Create announcement |
| PUT | /api/announcements/:id | Bearer + admin | Update announcement |

### Roles & Permissions

| GET | /api/roles | Bearer + roles.view | List all roles |

## 7. Authentication & Security

### JWT Flow
1. Client POSTs to /api/auth/login with loginId + password
2. Server verifies password hash with bcryptjs
3. Server signs JWT with HS256 (secret from JWT_SECRET env var)
4. Client stores token in localStorage as hunar_token
5. All subsequent requests include Authorization: Bearer <token>
6. authMiddleware verifies token, looks up user, resolves permissions

### Login IDs
- Students: HUN-S-YYYY-XXXX (e.g. HUN-S-2026-0001)
- Teachers: HUN-T-XXXX (e.g. HUN-T-0001)
- Admin: HUN-A-XXXX (e.g. HUN-A-0001)
- Email address also accepted

### Password Policy
- Minimum 8 characters
- Must contain uppercase, lowercase, and number
- Maximum 128 characters
- Hashed with bcryptjs (cost factor 10+)

### Rate Limiting
| Endpoint | Limit |
|---|---|
| /api/auth/login | 10 requests / 15 min |
| /api/auth/activate | 10 requests / hour |
| /api/auth/forgot-password | 5 requests / hour |
| /api/leads (enquiry forms) | 10 requests / 15 min |
| All other API | 240 requests / 15 min |

### Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Roles are stored in MongoDB with a permissions array. Built-in roles:
- role-super-admin: wildcard (*) — full access
- role-teacher: teaching and student-view permissions
- role-office-administrator: leads, fees, attendance view
- role-student: own data only

Custom roles can be created by admin with granular permissions from the permission library.

### Security Headers (Vercel edge)
- X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
- X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN
- X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block
- Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
- Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()

### Security Headers (Helmet / Express, API responses)
- Content-Security-Policy (enabled, configured per environment)
- HSTS (production only, includeSubDomains + preload)
- CORS: locked to https://hunar.courses and https://hunar.courses

### Known Security Fixes Applied
- Admin email no longer hardcoded in authMiddleware — reads from INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL env var
- Production console.error no longer dumps stack traces
- Public "Admin Portal" link removed from footer
- "Admin →" quick-access button removed from login page
- CSP enabled (was disabled)

## 8. SEO & AEO

### Meta Strategy
- Each route has a unique title, description (AEO-optimized), keywords
- Dual-layer: static in index.html (for crawlers on first load) + dynamic via SeoManager.jsx
- JSON-LD structured data: EducationalOrganization + LocalBusiness, Course, Article, FAQPage, ItemList
- Canonical tags on every page
- og:image:alt and twitter:image:alt on all pages
- noindex/nofollow on all portal/admin/login routes

### Geo / Local SEO (index.html)
- meta name="geo.region" content="IN-PB"
- meta name="geo.placename" content="Mullanpur Dakha, Ludhiana, Punjab, India"
- meta name="geo.position" content="30.8248;75.7315"
- ICBM coordinates

### Sitemap
- Location: /sitemap.xml (27 URLs)
- Includes lastmod, changefreq, priority
- Referenced in robots.txt
- Auto-generated at build time by scripts/prerender-seo.js

### AI Crawler Access
robots.txt explicitly allows: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

### Prerendering
Build script (scripts/prerender-seo.js) generates static HTML for all 27 public routes in dist/. Each prerendered file has:
- Correct title, meta description, OG tags, canonical
- JSON-LD structured data
- Crawlable static content (headings, paragraphs, links)

---

## 9. Data Models

### User
Fields: name, email, normalizedEmail, passwordHash, role, assignedId (loginId), roleId, status (active/suspended/pending_activation), invitationTokenHash, invitationExpiry, lastLogin

### Student
Fields: studentId (HUN-S-YYYY-XXXX), name, email, phone, course, batch, enrollmentStatus, assignedTeacher, joinDate

### Staff
Fields: staffId (HUN-T-XXXX), name, email, phone, designation, department, role, roleId, employmentStatus, assignedBatches

### Batch
Fields: name, course, timing, assignedTeacher, active (boolean)

### Assignment
Fields: title, description, batch, deadline, maxMarks, assignedBy, submissions[]

### Submission
Fields: assignmentId, studentId, content, submittedAt, marks, feedback, status

### Attendance
Fields: studentId, studentName, batch, date, status (present/absent/late), markedBy

### FeeRecord
Fields: studentId, studentName, course, totalFee, paidAmount, balance, dueDate, status

### Announcement
Fields: title, message, audience (students/staff/all), authorName, authorRole, publishDate, active

### Lead (Enquiry)
Fields: name, phone, email, course, message, source, status (new/contacted/enrolled/closed), createdAt

### AuditLog
Fields: actorName, actorRole, action, targetType, targetId, notes, timestamp

## 10. Environment Variables Required

```
PORT                        Express port (default 5000)
MONGODB_URI                 MongoDB Atlas connection string
JWT_SECRET                  Min 32-char random string
INVITATION_EXPIRY_HOURS     Default 72
INITIAL_ADMIN_NAME          First admin account name
INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL         First admin email (also used as super-admin fallback)
INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD      First admin password
SMTP_HOST                   smtp.gmail.com
SMTP_PORT                   587
SMTP_USER                   Gmail address
SMTP_PASS                   Google App Password
SMTP_FROM                   Display name + email
INQUIRY_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL  Where enquiry emails go
NODE_ENV                    production
ALLOWED_ORIGINS             https://hunar.courses,https://hunar.courses
```

## 11. Known Issues & Debugging Guide

### 503 on all /api/* routes
Cause: MongoDB not connected on Vercel.
Fix:
1. Verify MONGODB_URI is set in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables
2. In MongoDB Atlas → Network Access → add 0.0.0.0/0 (Vercel uses dynamic IPs)
3. Redeploy after fixing env vars
4. Test: GET /api/health should return {"status":"ok","database":"connected"}

### Login returns 401 immediately
Cause: Wrong loginId format or incorrect password.
Check: loginId must be HUN-S-YYYY-XXXX or HUN-T-XXXX or email address.
Admin reset: npm run reset-password

### Invitation email not received
Cause: SMTP not configured or Google App Password incorrect.
Fix: Use Google App Password (not account password). Enable 2FA on Gmail first.

### Student portal shows no data
Cause: Student's batch not assigned or teacher not assigned to batch.
Fix: Admin → Batches → assign teacher. Admin → Students → assign batch.

### Attendance batch select shows blank
Fixed: loadAllData now auto-selects batches[0].name on load.

### Course select blank in Create Batch modal
Fixed: openAddBatch pre-selects courseOptions[0].title.

### CinematicIntro blocks homepage on first visit
Fixed: intro now starts 800ms after page load so logo/hero are visible first.

### vercel.json "Invalid config" error
Fixed: file must contain exactly one JSON object. Remove $schema if it causes schema validator conflicts.

### Admin panel shows "Unable to load admin dashboard"
Same as 503 issue — MongoDB not connected. See fix above.

---

## 12. Build & Deploy

```bash
# Local development
npm run dev           # Vite + Express dev server

# Production build
npm run build         # vite build + scripts/prerender-seo.js

# Start production server (self-hosted)
npm run start         # node server/server.js

# Lint
npm run lint          # oxlint

# Integration tests
npm run test:integration

# Reset admin password
npm run reset-password
```

### Vercel deploy
Push to main branch → Vercel auto-deploys.
Build command: npm run build
Output directory: dist
API: api/index.js (Vercel serverless function)
